remarks: Welcome home to this beautifully updated studio apartment, perfectly located in vibrant Downtown Stamford! This stylish unit features modern finishes throughout, including sleek flooring, a contemporary kitchen with stainless steel appliances, and a refreshed bathroom for a clean, comfortable feel. Enjoy peace of mind with heat, cooking gas, and hot water INCLUDED in the rent-a rare find that makes city living even more affordable. Just steps away from top restaurants, shopping, entertainment, and public transportation, this studio offers the perfect blend of convenience and comfort. Ideal for professionals, commuters, or anyone looking to enjoy all that Stamford has to offer!
